text:
Mira (eval infra): Heads up — eval-runner shows weird lag in windowed metric updates for the quantized v2 bringup. Diff card stays blank until manual refresh. cc @Ana (mlops) @Sam
Ana (mlops): seeing same. heatmap only populates ~30s after run finishes. looks like websocket event not arriving? :thinking_face:
Sam: I can repro with a small local run. runner emits metrics but dashboard consumer only reads the initial snapshot. attaching quick logs:
```
[2026-03-15T12:13:04Z] runner: finished batch 42
[2026-03-15T12:13:04Z] metrics: windowed_update queued {model: "quant-v2", run_id: "r-11"}
[2026-03-15T12:13:34Z] dashboard: fetch_snapshot -> empty
[2026-03-15T12:13:34Z] dashboard: ws_connection: open
[2026-03-15T12:14:06Z] dashboard: received metric_delta {type: "summary_only"}
```
Mira (eval infra): hmm could be the schema change pushed with the quantized bringup — consumer expects `series` field but runner now sends `buckets` (schema v2). linked: https://redwood.internal/schemas/metric-window/v2
Jorge: CI also flaky: canary eval-ci/metrics-watcher timed out yesterday. error in CI logs: "no update for 5m". this lines up. @dev-ci-bot can you dump the last run logs?
dev-ci-bot: CI: eval-ci/metrics-watcher - job timed out after 15m. Last log snippet:
```
2026-03-14T22:02:11Z - watcher: awaiting metric_window:update
2026-03-14T22:07:11Z - watcher: no update for 5m, triggering alert
```
Ana (mlops): quick workaround: force dashboard to poll every 10s instead of ws-only. not ideal but stops blank diffcards. we should still fix producer events.
Sam: I'll open a consumer-side tolerant patch to accept both `series` and `buckets` shapes, short term fix. Will add a feature-flagged fallback.
Mira (eval infra): thanks. please also open an issue for runner to emit `metric_window:update` event with full payload on run completion. tagging eng-runtime and infra router.
Sam: doing PR now -> draft PR #4321: "dashboard: accept metric-window v2 shape". test plan included.
Mira (eval infra): assign to eng-runtime to do the emitter fix. if canary keeps failing we should rollback quant-v2 images.
Liam: I can coordinate rollback and release notes if needed tonight. ping me when PR is merged or if CI keeps failing.
Sam: PR opened and CI running. will follow up if watcher still times out. :thumbsup:
Ana (mlops): created issue #789 in backlog, linked PR and CI trace.
Mira (eval infra): great — thanks everyone. follow-up: if anyone sees blank diffcards, hit refresh or use `?poll=1` query param until patch lands.
